earnings.title: Greta Edgar Borza
highlights: Net sales of $4.4 billion, an increase of 7% versus prior year
Record third quarter reported earnings per diluted share (EPS) of $2.12 and adjusted EPS of $2.25, an increase of 6% versus prior year
I am extremely encouraged by our performance as we delivered record third quarter EPS, an increase of +6% year over year.
Organic sales increased 5% year over year with growth led by our differentiated aerospace and architectural coatings Latin America businesses
outlook: Updating full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to a higher midpoint and tighter range of $7.90 to $8.10
We are raising the midpoint of our full-year adjusted earnings per share outlook and narrowing the guidance range to $7.90 to $8.10.
We are improving our earnings outlook, resulting in a higher midpoint with a full-year adjusted earnings per share guidance range of $7.90 to $8.10.
With headquarters in Pittsburgh, we market and sell in more than 50 countries and reported net sales of $15.9 billion in 2025.

items.heading: Increases in prices and declines in the availability of raw materials could negatively impact our financial results.
The pace of economic growth and level of economic and geopolitical uncertainty could have a negative impact on our results of operations and cash flows.
Fluctuations in foreign currency exchange rates could affect our financial results.

Public health crises, including pandemics and the measures taken by public health and government authorities to address them, have adversely impacted our financial condition and results of operations in the past, and could adversely impact us in the future.
We are subject to existing and evolving standards relating to the protection of the environment.
We are involved in a number of lawsuits and claims, and we may be involved in future lawsuits and claims, in which substantial monetary damages are sought.
